mechanism: Remove any remaining survey-line periodicity (200 m line spacing in Area 1, 400 m in Area 2, flight azimuth 90 degrees, per the USGS summary) with an oriented notch filter before computing horizontal-gradient edges, so that magnetic contacts from fault-related contrast are not masked or mimicked by residual leveling. Whether any residue remains after the contractor's corrections is untested.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Residual line-periodic leveling artifacts after the contractor's tie-line and micro-leveling (USGS summary), plus lithologic contacts (intrusive and volcanic margins) that produce edges without displacement.

correlation_and_overlap_vs_registry.method_note: Spearman over all 12,279,160 cells (mostly zeros, so ties dominate). Dots are cells > 0. The other session reported rho = -0.0009 with an unrecorded method (IR-74-22).

leakage_canary.rule: A single feature alone should not reach AUC > 0.90 on the holdout. Above 0.90 means leakage.
leakage_canary.result: No AUC was computed here. tests/test_canary.py on main returns early when its data is absent and so passes without asserting (IR-74-24). A green test in this environment is not evidence of no leakage.

main_script.note: The NaN twin is a valid format, so exit 1 is a false rejection (IR-74-17).
